Wir bauen KI-Agenten, die Anfragen beantworten, Termine buchen und Angebote vorbereiten – und wir übergeben sie Ihnen mit Code und Daten. Vor dem Start legen wir gemeinsam eine Kennzahl fest, etwa „Antwortzeit auf Anfragen“. Nach dem Go-Live messen wir dieselbe Kennzahl noch einmal. So sehen Sie schwarz auf weiß, ob sich der Agent lohnt – statt es uns glauben zu müssen.
Danach gehört der Agent Ihnen. Den laufenden Betrieb übernehmen Sie selbst – oder auf Wunsch wir (NeXify Care, optional, monatlich kündbar).
30 Minuten, kostenlos. Danach wissen Sie, ob ein Audit sinnvoll ist – oder nicht.
01 · Die Zahl, an der Sie uns messen
Nicht „mehr Effizienz“. Eine Zahl, vorher und nachher.

Bevor wir bauen, legen wir gemeinsam fest, was gemessen wird – meist die Zeit bis zur ersten Antwort. Nach dem Go-Live messen wir dieselbe Zahl noch einmal. Hier sehen Sie, wie groß der Unterschied sein kann und wie sich unbeantwortete Anfragen summieren.
Balken maßstäblich: 4 Minuten sind 0,26 % von 26 Stunden.
– Ihre echte Zahl steht nach dem Audit fest und wird nach dem Go-Live gemessen.
Annahme: 23 % der Anrufe im Mittelstand bleiben unbeantwortet (Matelso, 2024). Ihr Wert kann abweichen – das Audit misst ihn.
Eine Anfrage kommt um 21:14 Uhr. Um 21:15 Uhr steht die Antwort.
So sieht die Kennzahl aus dem Alltag aus: vier Stationen, jede mit einer Regel, die Sie festlegen. Nichts davon ist Zufall, nichts passiert ohne Protokoll. Danach probieren Sie es selbst.
Jetzt Sie: Geben Sie NeXify AI einen echten Fall.

Wählen Sie Branche oder Auftrag, ändern Sie den Text und starten Sie den Lauf. Nichts wird gespeichert, nichts verschickt. Es sind vorbereitete Abläufe; im Betrieb rechnet NeXify AI one+ live und schreibt jeden Schritt ins Journal.

Die Bausteine im Detail – jeder erledigt eine Sache, die heute jemand von Hand macht.
Einstiegspreise netto, für Unternehmer. Fertiglösungs-Preise stehen nach dem Erstgespräch fest, weil sie vom Branding-Umfang abhängen.

Einmal entwickelt, immer wieder vermarktet: Jeden Baustein gibt es als Neuentwicklung zum Tagessatz oder als bestehende Lösung unter Ihrer Marke. Der Schieber zeigt, was sich dabei ändert – und was nicht.
Balken zeigen die Größenordnung relativ zueinander, keine Angebotswerte.
Sie sehen jeden Tag, was entstanden ist – nicht erst am Ende.

So läuft ein Entwicklungstag während des Aufbaus – einer der drei bis fünf Tage, die Sie einmalig bezahlen. Im laufenden Betrieb fällt kein Tagessatz mehr an. Die Uhr läuft von selbst; tippen Sie auf eine Stunde, um dort zu bleiben.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: Initial snapshot had CI-only wording and legacy tiers/fallbacks. During reconciliation Root introduced llm-policy.json for all repository-controlled managed LLM calls, broadened AGENTS, bound brain model declarations and retired automatic tier substitution. Internal SDK primitives already pin1017/high; the public orientation is still a separate deterministic mode.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.impact: Without scoped unification, live chat/agents/research can diverge from CI or quietly choose another model. A file change alone does not reconcile an external running deployment.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Use exact deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 and high for managed calls across the scopes declared by llm-policy. Preserve explicit customer BYOK selection as its separate authorized/funded scope. Retained role/tier names must not reactivate automatic substitution. Voice/video/embeddings and the assistant host model are distinct capabilities.
code_check_recommendations: Read one trusted central model policy at server boundaries; compare mirrors/adapter constants in CI.
Assert final serialized provider model/reasoning, require_parameters and allow_fallbacks:false; reject injected overrides and unsupported capabilities.
Test provider failure as one attempt with no model substitution, downgrade, blind paid retry or generic string-model gateway shortcut.
Keep independent deployment readback/wire evidence; do not infer global rollout from repository edits.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: A1 is a separate paused customer project. Historical plans/contracts may still discuss its old data/stack; N2 is read-only reference.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.impact: Blind combination can import customer data, history, branding, credentials or false delivery/SSO dependencies.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Apply the current source boundary before reuse. Select components only with source/commit/path, purpose, license/adaptation and tests; no whole customer import or inferred database association.
code_check_recommendations: Fail agency path/package/dependency checks for forbidden apps/portal or customer data/source imports.
Require provenance records for adopted components; tests and names alone do not establish rights.
Classify N2 and old A1 references as historical, never execute them as current instructions.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: Current selfservice policy separates a one-off500-cent managed trial exception,1000-cent regular prepaid minimum, and5000-cent older document proposal. The trial exception is not a general prepaid price change.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.impact: Flattening these sources can charge the wrong amount, bypass merchant/tax controls, or block a specifically authorized trial with an obsolete blanket minimum.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Use the latest user-authorized scoped trial exception without asking for its general approval again; bind actual charges to the correct account/trial, merchant, currency, idempotency and verified operational funded route. Keep regular1000 policy separate and mark older5000 text historical.
code_check_recommendations: Test trial500 accepted only for eligible initial trial/account/tenant and matching verified payment amount/currency.
Test regular500 rejected and regular1000 minimum preserved; no trial reset/new free credit via relogin/checkout/key rotation.
Reject UI/LLM-provided amount, estimated cost-as-zero, duplicate grants, mismatched provider/payment results.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: Public customer registration is the current product requirement. Disabled/incomplete Clerk UI, protected preview access or earlier closed/status-only entry are operational states, not a new policy forbidding registration.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.impact: Confusing these states either leaves the requested selfservice unimplemented or grants internal roles because someone can sign up.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Implement verified email, server-activated own workspace and explicit idempotent24h start; registration grants only customer scope. Keep authentic readiness failures visible and never infer admin/other-tenant membership from public signup.
code_check_recommendations: Test verified identity alone cannot read/write private tenant/internal data.
Test explicit start only after prerequisites; one atomic grant; expiry and conversion preserve identity/settings.
Test absent/bad public config yields truthful unavailable UI; enabling a flag alone does not prove DNS/TLS/provider readiness.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Keep deterministic mode clearly labelled and track the real authorized/funded model path separately. Do not silently substitute fake data or company-paid fallback for missing user funding or unresolved provider results.
code_check_recommendations: Assert interim responses explicitly identify no live model and do not claim send/book/payment.
For live mode verify server credential binding, source/tenant, budget reservation, final provider wire, usage reconciliation and truthful error states.
Separate mocked SDK evidence, source/model catalog evidence and actual successful provider evidence.

Do not start GEO recommendation experiments or claim rankings/discoverability percentages from a document or source inventory.

Record actual provider/region capability and account mode; disallow unsupported EU guarantees.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: Rules and source statements can appear in web pages, prototype content, model responses, diffs, MCP annotations, email and generated indexes. Their imperative form does not grant rights or replace current instruction hierarchy.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Carry source identity/hash/trust/version/scope through retrieval. Keep executable policy in an approved allowlisted loader and treat content as quoted evidence. The LLM recommends within server gates; it does not approve model/cost/tool/tenant changes.
code_check_recommendations: Test ignore-rules/pay/send/exfiltrate instructions in retrieved pages/diffs/tool responses remain inert data.
Verify tool name, schema, tenant and action allowlist immediately before effect; output provenance cannot substitute for authorization.
Use WRITE→INDEX→EXACT READ-BACK→CONTENT COMPARE for ingestion success; HTTP200 alone is not success.

selected_semantic_reconciliations.observation: Feature state machine/WIP and layered checks require actual nonempty evidence; generated inventories/architecture contracts and green mocks do not establish final business readiness.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.impact: Direct passing edits, stale evidence, swallowed shell failures or raceful writes can wrongly signal completion.
selected_semantic_reconciliations.resolution_recommendation: Use the actual feature verifier and required scoped checks. Advisory locking coordinates cooperating writers, not arbitrary filesystem CAS; require correct original snapshot, atomic record and explicit limitations.
code_check_recommendations: Reject zero-check layers, failure/failed pipeline swallowed by shell conditional, stale source snapshot and unauthorized direct passing updates.
Use current required source/test/deployment evidence for the layer; do not re-run broad suites without changes or unresolved concern.
Keep user final acceptance and domain/legal/production gates distinct from test pass.

Keep original content/state coverage and visual/user-journey acceptance separate from route count and source hashes.
No source/caption/figure crop or simplification may silently erase the accepted original layout/function.

Intersect non-conflicting safety, source-boundary, authorization, amount/region and capability constraints.
